posts.text: The Brewers go into NLDS Game 3 seeking to snap an 11-game losing streak in postseason road games. Their last playoff win on the road was a 4-0 triumph over current Padre Walker Buehler in Game 3 of the 2018 NLCS at Dodger Stadium. www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
